assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-ready transparent PNG sprite sheet for an interactive realistic financial garden, 3 columns by 2 rows, intended canvas 1536x1024, six exactly equal cells. NOT a UI mockup. Render exactly six separate terracotta flowerpots in a rigid 3x2 grid on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, no checkerboard painted into the image, no background color. Each cell contains the SAME unglazed warm terracotta pot, same shape, same physical scale, same front three-quarter camera slightly looking down to see soil, same lighting warm natural morning light from upper left, same bottom baseline and tiny soft contact shadow. Pots have authentic clay texture, dark visible soil and clear dimensional volume: photographic botanical/product realism, sophisticated lifelike 3D render, NOT cartoon, NOT flat vector, NOT plastic toy, no faces. Each pot is centered horizontally within its cell; its bottom is at 92 percent of cell height, soil rim at 73 percent. All foliage must stay inside its own cell with generous transparent padding and never overlap neighboring cells. Read left to right top row then bottom row: cell1 bare moist soil, planted seed invisible below soil, NO plant above soil. Cell2 one small green seedling with two cotyledon leaves. Cell3 a young cosmos plant with a short stem and several delicate green leaves. Cell4 a fuller established green cosmos plant with branching stems and closed flower buds, no open flowers. Cell5 the same cosmos plant with two soft pink open cosmos flowers and green buds. Cell6 the same cosmos plant at full bloom with seven tasteful pink and ivory cosmos blossoms. Natural plant morphology, airy realistic stems. The pot occupies roughly 44 percent of cell width, mature foliage may occupy 75 percent. Growth changes foliage size only, NEVER pot size. Keep all pots identical and vertically aligned within respective cells. No text, no numbers, no labels, no borders, no decorative props, no watermark. Output is ONE cohesive sprite-sheet asset, not a presentation.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: background plate for a 2.5D interactive garden with potted plants added by code in the foreground. Wide landscape canvas about 1536x1024. A serene small realistic sunlit courtyard garden, warm limestone and lightly weathered terracotta paving, low lush planted border and a subtle warm plaster garden wall toward the distant upper part, gently blurred green fern and flowering shrubs at the outer edges, natural morning light from upper left, soft believable shadows, botanical photography with real textures and cinematic but calm warmth. Camera slightly elevated, looking toward the back of the courtyard, consistent with front three-quarter product photos of flowerpots placed on the ground. Composition: the LOWER TWO THIRDS must be a CLEAR EMPTY continuous stone patio surface, evenly illuminated, reserved to later place interactive potted plants. Plants and border concentrated in the TOP THIRD and thin outer edges only. No pots, no containers, no furniture, no people, no tools, no text, no UI, no icons, no watermark. Not a dense forest, not an illustrated cartoon, no fantasy glowing particles. This is a clean natural setting with generous open foreground and believable depth for Alcancía Viva's realistic potted-goal garden.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached transparent six-stage botanical sprite sheet. Preserve the beautiful photographic terracotta material, cosmos species, green leaves, pink and ivory flowers, exact six growth stages, natural light direction and TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Change ONLY framing/scale/alignment so it works as a usable 3 columns x 2 rows sprite sheet of six equal square cells. Each cell is 512x512 on a 1536x1024 canvas. CRITICAL: every pot must be IDENTICAL in shape and size, approximately 224 pixels wide and 208 pixels tall, horizontally centered at cell x=256, with soil rim at cell y=270 and bottom of pot at cell y=480. Keep these coordinates and pot dimensions identical in ALL SIX cells. The upper roughly half of each cell is available for plant foliage, which grows upward from soil rim y=270. Young plants stay small. Mature leaves and flowers fit fully inside their own cell with no clipping and at least 25px transparent padding. Stage order unchanged: bare soil, tiny two-leaf seedling, young leafy cosmos, developed cosmos with closed buds, two open pink flowers, full pink/ivory flowering cosmos. The vessel never grows: only the plant above the soil grows. No opaque or colored glow behind objects, no painted checkerboard, no frame, no labels, no text. Keep a very subtle small transparent contact shadow below each pot. Output one clean consistent transparent sprite-sheet asset with same realistic finish.
